Application Data.NAME: ABC Mail & Packaging Services
Application Data.DESCRIPTION OF OPERATIONS: ABC Mail & Packaging Services specializes in providing efficient and reliable mail and packaging solutions, including mailbox rentals, parcel shipping, and packaging supply sales. Our operations are focused on offering tailored services to individual and business clients while implementing strict protocols for handling, storage, and delivery of goods to mitigate risks such as theft and property damage. We maintain a secure environment with established safety measures and prioritize customer satisfaction through effective tracking systems for all shipments.

Application Data.DESCRIPTION OF LOSSES: On 03/12/2023, a package with an estimated value of $5,000 was reported stolen from our facility during off-hours. The claim has been submitted and is currently under review with the carrier. Additionally, on 08/25/2023, a customer reported a damaged package valued at $2,500 due to mishandling during transit. This incident has been resolved amicably with the customer receiving a full refund. Total losses reported stand at $7,500.
Application Data.HOURS OF OPERATION: Mon-Fri 9:00 AM - 6:00 PM; Sat 10:00 AM - 4:00 PM
Application Data.SAFE/VAULT DETAILS: Class 1, Grade A, UL Listed, Central Station Alarm System
Application Data.OTHER PROTECTION: Secure perimeter fencing with 24-hour monitored security system and on-site watchpersons during off-hours.
